title: Thirty years of engineering for Papua New Guinea
lead: R. Napitalai Limited is a Port Moresby engineering consultancy delivering civil, structural, geotechnical and environmental engineering nationwide.
body:
## Who we are

At R. Napitalai Limited we deliver professional, practical engineering solutions tailored to each client's needs. We work across the civil, residential, commercial, industrial, geotechnical and environmental sectors.

Our services include site investigations, conceptual design, project management, construction documentation, and liaison with architects, builders, contractors and government authorities.

On many projects we provide the civil and structural engineering and then manage the work from concept through to completion, acting as project engineer or supervisor on site and handling quantity measurement and quality assurance.
image_alt: RNL staff on a site visit
statement:
Five, ten, fifteen years ago I could never have imagined that R. Napitalai Limited would become a major part of the infrastructure transformation of Papua New Guinea. Over the years we have built a reputation for a high standard of engineering excellence.

With a dedicated focus on design, RNL has emerged as one of the leading consultants in its field. Supported by a young, vibrant team of engineers, draftspeople and support staff, we have grown immensely. I thank everyone for their confidence in our business, and assure you that we are ready to take the next leap forward to becoming the authority in engineering in PNG.
